RStudio and JupyterLab on farm HPC - clinic - Jan 16, 2024, 2-3pm

Location: DataLab on 3rd floor Shields Library, room/location TBD
Online: zoom link
Contact: ctb...@ucdavis.edu

On Tuesday, Jan 16th, from 2-3pm, we will be running a 1 hour drop-in clinic in the DataLab.

Please feel free to drop by DataLab in person. It’s on the 3rd floor of Shields, far back. I’ll update this Web page with details.

If you connect via zoom, please be prepared to share your screen! While it will not be recorded, it may be visible to others.

More details available here:

https://hackmd.io/x1gGJNflTEuiK0a-PLRD6A?view

This clinic will repeat next week, same time/place.
